# FunDS Lite — Design System Specification
# Version: 1.0.0 | Updated: 2026-04
# Fetch this file to get the complete system spec in one request.
# Human manifest: https://funds-manifest.vercel.app

---

## OVERVIEW

FunDS Lite is the public-facing slice of the Amartha FunDS design system.
It covers just enough tokens, components, and patterns to keep the mobile app
and internal dashboard in sync.

Surfaces: Mobile (primary), Internal Dashboard

---

## COLOR TOKENS

### Brand (Primary Purple)
primary-50:  #FEF3FF  — tinted backgrounds, badge fills
primary-200: #E5B8EF  — hover backgrounds
primary-300: #D68EE4  — illustrative / decorative
primary-400: #A642B7  — secondary actions
primary-500: #853291  — PRIMARY — buttons, links, active states
primary-600: #732C7C  — hover / pressed state for primary
primary-700: #612966  — on-light text emphasis
primary-900: #3D1042  — deep emphasis

### Neutral
neutral-white: #FFFFFF  — surface / card backgrounds
neutral-50:    #F9FAF8  — page background
neutral-200:   #E5E7EB  — borders (default)
neutral-400:   #C6CAD0  — placeholder text
neutral-500:   #8E95A3  — disabled state
neutral-600:   #6B7280  — caption / secondary text
neutral-700:   #525C6A  — secondary text emphasis
neutral-900:   #111928  — default text (darkest)

### Saturated — Status Colors
blue-50:    #EDF7FF  | blue-500:   #056DCE  — informational
green-50:   #E4FCEF  | green-500:  #009C6A  — success / funded
orange-50:  #FDF4E9  | orange-500: #F7941D  — warning / pending
red-50:     #FFF4F3  | red-500:    #D73630  — error / overdue / danger
yellow-50:  #FFFED9  | yellow-500: #EAB20B  — accent / review

---

## SEMANTIC TOKEN ALIASES

Use these aliases in components — prefer over raw color names.

text-default:     #111928  (neutral-900) — primary readable text
text-caption:     #6B7280  (neutral-600) — secondary / supporting text
text-disabled:    #8E95A3  (neutral-500) — disabled labels
text-placeholder: #C6CAD0  (neutral-400) — input placeholder text
text-link:        #853291  (primary-500) — clickable links

border-default:   #E5E7EB  (neutral-200) — card and input borders
border-light:     #F9FAF8  (neutral-50)  — subtle dividers

bg-overlay:       rgba(17, 25, 40, 0.8)  — modal/drawer overlays

---

## TYPOGRAPHY

Font Family: Inter (Google Fonts)
Weights: 500 (regular), 700 (bold) — NO OTHER WEIGHTS PERMITTED

### Type Scale
text-24: 24px / weight 700 / letter-spacing -0.02em  → Heading 24
text-20: 20px / weight 700 / letter-spacing -0.01em  → Heading 20
text-18: 18px / weight 500 / letter-spacing 0        → Body 18 (primary reading)
text-16: 16px / weight 500 / letter-spacing 0        → Body 16 (secondary)
text-14: 14px / weight 500 / letter-spacing 0        → Body 14 (tables, compact)
text-12: 12px / weight 500 / letter-spacing +0.04em  → Label / Caption (UPPERCASE)
text-10: 10px / weight 500 / letter-spacing +0.06em  → Overline / Micro (UPPERCASE)

---

## SPACING

Base rhythm: 4px
Tailwind classes use numeric suffix = pixel value.

space-0:  0px   (p-0,  m-0)
space-2:  2px   (p-2,  m-2)
space-4:  4px   (p-4,  m-4)
space-8:  8px   (p-8,  m-8)
space-12: 12px  (p-12, m-12)
space-16: 16px  (p-16, m-16)
space-20: 20px  (p-20, m-20)
space-24: 24px  (p-24, m-24)
space-32: 32px  (p-32, m-32)
space-40: 40px  (p-40, m-40)
space-48: 48px  (p-48, m-48)

FORBIDDEN: 5, 6, 10, 15, 25, 30px — never use values not in the scale above.

---

## BORDER RADIUS

rounded-none: 0px    — sharp corners
rounded-2:    2px    — micro
rounded-4:    4px    — subtle
rounded-6:    6px    — small (sm) — chips, tags
rounded-8:    8px    — DEFAULT — buttons, inputs
rounded-12:   12px   — cards, modals
rounded-16:   16px   — large containers
rounded-20:   20px   — XL panels
rounded-24:   24px   — hero sections
rounded-32:   32px   — decorative
rounded-40:   40px   — pill-like large
rounded-full: 9999px — pill / circular

Primary radius for interactive elements: 8px
Card radius: 12px
Small element radius: 6px

---

## COMPONENTS

### Button
Shape:    pill (border-radius 9999px)
Variants: primary | secondary | outline (tertiary) | ghost | danger
Sizes:    xs (12px) | sm (12px) | default (14px) | lg (16px) | xl (16px)
States:   default | hover | active | focus-visible | disabled
Font:     weight 700

Token map:
- primary:    bg #853291 (gradient overlay), hover bg #732C7C, text white
              box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #732C7C, 0 2px 3px rgba(133,50,145,0.3)
- secondary:  bg white, border #853291, text #853291, hover tint bg
- outline:    bg white, border #E5E7EB, text #111928, hover border #C6CAD0
- ghost:      bg transparent, border transparent, text #853291, hover bg #FEF3FF
- danger:     bg #D73630, border #D73630, text white, hover bg #AC2B26

Disabled: neutral-200 bg, neutral-500 text, cursor not-allowed, no shadow
Focus ring: 2px white + 4px #E5B8EF (primary-200)
Class naming: ds-btn ds-btn-{variant} [ds-btn-xs|sm|lg|xl]

### Input
Radius: 8px | Border: #E5E7EB | Focus ring: #FEF3FF (3px) + border #853291
States: default | focus | valid (border #009C6A) | error (border #D73630)
Supports: prefix element (left adornment) | suffix element (right adornment)
Variants: text input | select | textarea

### Badge
Shape: pill (border-radius 9999px) | Padding: 3px 10px | Font: 12px/500
Variants:
- primary: bg #FEF3FF, text #732C7C
- blue:    bg #EDF7FF, text #0457A5
- green:   bg #E4FCEF, text #007D55
- orange:  bg #FDF4E9, text #AD540A
- red:     bg #FFF4F3, text #AC2B26
- yellow:  bg #FFFED9, text #996F03
- neutral: bg #F9FAF8, text #6B7280, border #E5E7EB

### Card
Radius: 12px | Border: 1px solid #E5E7EB | Background: #FFFFFF | Padding: 20px

---

## TAILWIND CONFIG REFERENCE

The locked Tailwind config is the single source of truth for utility classes.
Only generate classes derivable from this config — never use arbitrary values.

colors.primary.500 = #853291
colors.neutral.900 = #111928
fontFamily.sans    = Inter
fontWeight.regular = 500
fontWeight.bold    = 700
spacing.*          = see spacing table above
borderRadius.*     = see radius table above

---

## DO / DON'T GUARDRAILS

DO:
✓ Use primary-500 (#853291) for all primary actions
✓ Use Inter at weight 500 or 700 only
✓ Use spacing values from the defined scale (0,2,4,8,12,16,20,24,32,40,48)
✓ Use semantic token names (text-default, border-default) over raw colors
✓ Use rounded-8 for buttons/inputs, rounded-12 for cards
✓ Pair status colors with their 50-tint background (e.g. red-500 on red-50 bg)

DON'T:
✗ Never use arbitrary Tailwind values like w-[437px] or text-[#abc]
✗ Never invent hex values not in this token set
✗ Never use font-weight 400, 600, or 800
✗ Never use spacing values not in the defined scale (e.g. 5px, 10px, 15px)
✗ Never use Google Fonts other than Inter
✗ Never use purple colors from generic palettes — only primary-* tokens

---

## STARTER PROMPTS

### Build a fund dashboard card:
"Using FunDS Lite tokens, build a React card component showing fund name,
AUM, IRR, and status badge. Use rounded-12, border-default, and p-20."

### Build a data table:
"Using FunDS Lite, build a table with text-14 body, neutral-200 borders,
neutral-50 header background, and status badges for fund state."

### Build a form:
"Using FunDS Lite inputs with rounded-8, border-default, and primary-500
focus ring. Include a $ prefix input for amount and a select for fund type."

---

## AMARTHA PRODUCT CONTEXT

Amartha Financial (https://amartha.com/) is a micro-finance lending company focused on
productive micro loans for grassroot women in Indonesia.

### Product Suite

Productive Loan:
- Modal         — Digital loan product (primary borrower product)
- Group Loan    — Non-digital group loan (deprecated; migrating to Modal)

Funding / Investment:
- B2B Funding   — Institutional funding (not available in AmarthaFin App)
- Celengan      — Retail investment, primarily for grassroot market
- GGS (Grassroot Growth Series) — Retail investment for middle-upper class investors

PPOB (Payment Point Online Bank):
- PPOB          — B2C bill payment features
- AmarthaLink   — Agent-based PPOB feature

Wallet:
- Poket         — In-app wallet for transactions within the Amartha ecosystem

### Platforms

- AmarthaFin App  — Consumer-facing mobile app (iOS & Android).
                    Primary platform for borrowers, investors, and PPOB users.
- NG-MIS          — Internal Management Information System for Amartha ops/staff.
                    Potentially evolving into a CRM.
- A-Partner App   — Internal app for field partners/agents.
